Alex.day_scenario: Alex wakes at 6:30 AM to join a project briefing from the home office, then heads out while listening to a business audiobook during his commute. He spends the day coordinating team deliverables and grabbing a quick lunch at his desk before returning home to wind down from work responsibilities and retire at 23:00.

Leo.day_scenario: Leo wakes at 7:00 AM to stack wooden blocks in the hallway before heading out for his part-time preschool sessions. He returns in the afternoon to construct a tall tower near the entryway, carefully leaving it standing in the middle of the floor before beginning his bedtime preparations at 20:00.

Mia.day_scenario: Mia wakes at 7:00 AM to draw detailed pictures with her broad-tip crayons, frequently leaving the paper and supplies scattered across the dining table once she is done. After a quiet afternoon of coloring in the sunroom, she follows her steady rhythm and begins her wind-down routine at 20:30.
